verdict.rationale: Pulley has docs on setting up a cap table via an Excel template that becomes the source of truth, and tools for merging duplicate stakeholders, suggesting some import/cleanup workflow support. However, there is no evidence of a guided migration process from another cap table platform, no described validation/reconciliation steps against source documents, and no mention of white-glove or automated import verification. Missing for 10: dedicated migration-from-competitor workflow, explicit validation/reconciliation process against source documents, and any hands-on or independent evidence of this process working in practice.
